title: Waybill shortcodes
description: The shape of the waybill's shortcodes.json, the org's one map of shortcode to repository (pandoscope#59, pandoscope#61), in the format the thread ledger reads. The file is the map itself, or holds it under repos beside the forge settings forge and patterns. A key that starts with _, such as _comment, is a comment at the top and inside the map. Two rules stand in the loader (src/pandoscope/reinset/order.py), because a schema cannot state them: a repository has one shortcode, and no key is written twice.

shortcode.description: Two to five lowercase letters (decision 122), so that a name, a reference and a branch write it as it stands. The pattern ends in (?![\s\S]) and not in $, because Python's $ also matches before a final line feed.

repository.description: owner/repo in lowercase (decision 143), so that one repository has one spelling and one shortcode.
